title: Control Telemetry Correlator and Audit Package Composer
creator: Priya Singh
description: Build a service that correlates control mappings (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls) to live telemetry sources and composes audit-ready packages on demand. The correlator will normalize events from cloud telemetry (CloudTrail, VPC Flow, KMS logs), Redwood Console activity traces, Dedicated control-plane events, and retention-policy manifests, then produce signed, timestamped audit bundles scoped to geography and retention policies. These bundles should be verifiable by external auditors and include a machine-readable control-to-evidence index, sample artifacts, and an exportable human summary. Goals: reduce manual auditor requests by 80%, shorten audit prep time, and ensure region-aware custody for jurisdictional requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Generate an audit bundle for a given control set (e.g., CC6.3, A.8.1) that contains a control-index.json, raw log excerpts, signed manifests, and a human summary
Bundles can be scoped by geography and retention window and include proof of storage location (region) and encryption key id
Automated tests that exercise collector adapters for CloudTrail, S3 access logs, KMS, and Console events with simulated traffic
End-to-end demo: produce a SOC 2 snapshot for a sample tenant and ingest into a mock auditor portal
Audit bundles are immutable once sealed and retain cryptographic signatures for verification
comments: 2026-02-11 Priya S: Scoped initial feature set with Security. Decided to prioritize CloudTrail and Console events first, then add Dedicated control-plane events in phase 2.

2026-02-20 Marcus L: Spike completed for CloudTrail adapter. Key tradeoff: whether to copy logs into a regional sealed store or reference in-place with signed manifests. Recommend sealed-store for auditor convenience but will add reference mode for large historical datasets.
2026-02-27 Security (Emma Chen): Reviewed threat model. Require HSM-backed signing keys and retention tamper-detection. Flagged need for key-rotation policy in design.
2026-03-03 Eng WG (Rafael Ortega): Prototype repo created. Adapter interface defined: fetch(), normalize(), sample(). Need agreement on sampling strategy to balance cost vs. audit completeness.
2026-03-08 Marcus L: Design doc updated with artifact schema v1 (control-index.json, manifest.sig, samples/*.log, summary.md). Added acceptance tests and auditor verification script.

2026-03-12 Priya S: Stakeholder demo scheduled for 2026-03-18. Next steps: implement S3-backed sealed-store, HSM signing integration, and Console integration tests. Noted potential blocker: Dedicated infra must expose immutable snapshot endpoint (follow-up ENG-90211).
implementation_notes: Artifact format should be ZIP with a signed manifest and deterministic ordering to support reproducible hashes
Use existing telemetry ingest pipelines but add a lightweight normalization layer to map events to control ids
Retention and jurisdiction constraints must be applied at packaging time; include both actual storage region and a canonical region field
Expose an API endpoint /audit-bundles/create that accepts control_set, start_ts, end_ts, scope (tenant, project, region)
Provide a dry-run mode that returns bundle size estimate and list of included sources before sealing
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Large historical exports could be costly and slow. Mitigation: reference-mode bundles and incremental chunking
Risk: Auditors require raw logs we don't currently retain. Mitigation: provide a retention-requirements report and automated retention policy enforcement proposals
Risk: Signing key compromise. Mitigation: HSM-backed keys, key rotation plan, and signature transparency logs
